Each change, before and after

One card per graph item that changed a screen or a document. Before is the frame captured on Dev2 before the lane deployed; after is the frame the lane committed with its landing. Items with no before were changed before capture began.

S2blank vendor required before a sheet can be finalized (builder Quote details page + guided mode + server-side check); freight optional; licensing number read-onlyproven

Finalize refused until a blank vendor is entered.

A2opening screen columns add Blank Price, Blank Style Number, Created Date (after Quoted by, sortable); alignment fixedproven

Opening screen: heading now Cost Sheets; Blank price, Blank style # and Created columns added after Quoted by; numbers aligned under their headers; light theme by default.

A4opening screen Suggested sell column reads the MOQ tier, not the first tier (CS-00657 showed 7.55 from its 100-piece row while Qty said 144 MOQ)proven

CS-00657 and CS-00658 showed $7.55 (their 100-piece row) beside Qty 144 (MOQ). The Suggested sell column now reads the row's own quantity tier: $7.15.

P2cost sheet PDF shows margin est. in the top cost block (customer IMU stays off)proven

Cost sheet PDF: item details on one run across the top, cost block (total cost, suggested sell, quoted price, margin est.) above the comp, comp at full content width, MOQ row highlighted.

F1spreadsheet upload on the Rate Set that upserts rate lines by key, with preview and row errorsproven

Rate Set record page: upload a CSV of rate lines, preview shows rows to update (old value to new), rows to add, rows with problems; nothing writes until Apply.

N2sheet display name defaults to CS-[Dev Item title] on the summary page, editableproven

Summary page: the name defaults to CS plus the development item title, and the button reads Finalize cost sheet.

N3after Finalize the builder lands on the finalized sheet's own screen (View PDF, Create production copy) with a Back to development item link; no forced redirectproven

After Finalize: the builder stays on the finalized sheet with View PDF and Create production copy, and a Back to development item link; the old jump to the Development Item is gone.

B2comp as big as possible (top or side), details readable without scrolling away; pop-out preview fills the pageproven

Item details page: comp enlarged, details visible without scrolling away, comp URL field removed.

Pop-out preview fills the page.

C1per-size blank costs move to the Quote details page; core range picker (XS-L or XS-XL) one price; 2X-5X own upcharge; per-size prices show on each tier rowproven

Quote details: core size range picker at one price, extended size upcharges 2X to 5X, royalty rate beside licensing number, blank vendor required.

Tiers: each break shows the extended-size prices (2X at 9.45 on the 144 break from a 1.50 upcharge).

D1each treatment shows its rate as it is ticked; override field shows the standard rate beside itproven

Decoration page: each treatment shows its rate when ticked, the override shows the standard rate beside it, and the price breakdown appears here before the summary.

D4embroidery and DTF enabled for Contract mode (grids already in the rate set); Full Package gaps reportedproven

Contract mode: embroidery and DTF enabled and priced from the contract grid.

E1ladder 144/288/576/1200/2400/3600 then +1200; preload MOQ plus next three; Add tier button staysproven

Tiers page: opens with the MOQ and the next three standard breaks already filled; Add tier still adds the next step.

E2a lower real-order break becomes the MOQ, updates the sheet MOQ field, sorts to the topproven

A lower quantity typed into a row becomes the MOQ, moves to the top, and updates the sheet's MOQ.

E3customer retail formatted as dollars and cents; customer margin per break beside our marginproven

Customer retail in dollars and cents; each break shows the customer's margin beside ours.

Q1guided mode follows the app's own Continue: after the person leaves a page with the builder's button, the guide advances to the new page's first step instead of stranding its card on the old page and re-offering itproven

Guided mode after the app's own Continue: before, the guide stays on Decoration with its card off screen and the overlay dimming Tiers; after, the guide lands on the Tiers page's first step.
